svg.text: 1. Hinge-axis straightness 0.5 over the 840 mm span. This is the tolerance that decides whether the leaf binds.
2. Hinge bosses sit ABOVE the leaf edge, not under it, or they foul the inner skin.
3. The gutter bonds to the shell above this part and drains outboard through the two C-pillar drains, discharging BELOW and OUTSIDE the seal line.
4. JW Winco GN 7233 is a LINKAGE, not a fixed pivot. This drawing shows the design-intent axis. Re-check against the vendor CAD coupler curve before release.
NOT RELEASED FOR FABRICATION. Uncalibrated against the physical vehicle. No FEA performed.
